title: Saudi Arabian Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish featuring marinated kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of spicy sauce for added flavor.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine kebabs, aromatic onions, saudi spice blend, and 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix well.
2. Let the mixture marinate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. Meanwhile, prepare spicy sauce by combining 1/2 cup yogurt, 1 tbsp harissa, and 1 tbsp lemon juice.
7. Grill the serrano peppers for 2-3 minutes, until slightly charred.
8. Serve kebabs hot with spicy sauce and garnished with grilled serrano peppers.
